t: Cheng Lou - On the Spectrum of Abstraction at react-europe 2016

recs.x:
If you've read some of the classics, such as Structure and Interpretation of Computer Programs (1979, Gerald Jay Sussman and Hal Abelson) [2], this talk is a really interesting look at the state of affairs on abstraction circa 2016.

[1]: [link]

A quick comparison with Angular: @Component({template, style}) seems composable if we stretch a lot. But why make template and style in the decorator... They are not something we consider most abstract at all.

The function is the simplest yet composable abstraction over the template, Cheng Lou also has a really excellent talk on the topic:
 [link]

I know, this isn't a novel concept. There was a good talk about the spectrum of abstractions and the tradeoffs of template languages vs React's approach at React Europe a couple of years ago (in fact, he goes into that this means there are some optimizations that are simply unavailable to React): [link]
